offering_description.value: Owns, leases and operates secure detention, correctional and processing facilities, and residential reentry centers, for government agencies. Also provides electronic monitoring, supervision and case management services for people in community programs. Revenue comes mainly from per-diem payments under government contracts.

primary_services.value: secure detention facility management; correctional facility operation; residential reentry center programs; electronic monitoring and supervision; community-based case management

customer_segment.value: B2G: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, U.S. Marshals Service, Federal Bureau of Prisons, state corrections departments, foreign governments

end_markets.value: immigration detention; criminal justice and corrections; offender reentry and community supervision

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-diem payments for detainees and inmates housed in managed facilities; project or contract: government contracts for electronic monitoring, supervision and reentry programs; rental or leasing: some facilities leased to government agencies
revenue_model.category: service fees; project or contract; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns, leases and runs detention and reentry facilities, serving government agencies; service provider: provides monitoring, supervision and rehabilitation programs to government agencies

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, plus Australia, South Africa and the United Kingdom

specialization.value: related lines: secure detention facilities, reentry centers, and electronic monitoring and community supervision services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: competitive bids and contracts directly with federal, state and foreign government agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: operates detention facilities under government contracts, subject to ICE and Bureau of Prisons standards, PREA, state licensing and audits
